tools.name: packetstream_search
tools.description: Run a live web search on the world's most-used search engine and get the results as Markdown and structured JSON, as people in the chosen country, language or location see them. PacketStream runs the search, which can help when searching directly is blocked or gets CAPTCHAs. type=search accepts ever

tools.name: packetstream_fetch
tools.description: Fetch one public http(s) URL live and return its main content as Markdown, with the final URL, HTTP status and title. Useful for reading a packetstream_search result or a URL the user gave. It returns the page itself rather than a summary, and the request goes out through PacketStream's residential
